Name: Simple UI Themes 2 (New Update)
Author: Xsyy
Description:
[b]SIMPLE UI THEMES 2[/b]

Give Stardew Valley’s menus a darker seasonal look with 12 illustrated themes inspired by rain, crops, flowers, forage, orchards, beaches, mines and winter scenery.

Each season includes three presets. You can let the theme change automatically with the season, assign any preset to any season, or use one theme throughout the year.

[b]FEATURES[/b]
• 12 dark seasonal themes
• Three presets for each season
• Dark readable panels without using pure black
• High-contrast text
• Illustrated corner and side decorations
• Static glow with no animations
• Seasonal backgrounds behind the farmer
• Separate menu, HUD, tooltip and background settings
• Support for standard, 48-slot and 60-slot backpacks
• Adaptive decoration placement for different menus and UI scales
• Support for all 12 built-in Stardew Valley languages
• Optional Generic Mod Config Menu support
• No save data or gameplay changes

[b]THEMES[/b]

[b]Spring[/b]
• Rain Blue - Spring Showers
• Fresh Green - Spring Forage
• Tulip Coral - Trellis Garden

[b]Summer[/b]
• Moss Green - Green Rain
• Melon Pink - Summer Crops
• Ocean Teal - Tide Pool

[b]Autumn[/b]
• Storm Grey - Autumn Downpour
• Apple Red - Orchard Night
• Aubergine Purple - Root Cellar

[b]Winter[/b]
• Snow Blue - Valley Snowfall
• Geode Violet - Frozen Quarry
• Crocus Purple - Winter Forage

[b]DECORATIONS[/b]
Every preset includes its own corner and side artwork.
The decorations adapt to the visible menu panels and leave space around tabs, buttons, labels, colour selectors and scrollbars. Complete ornaments move, shrink or disappear when there is not enough safe space instead of being cropped.
Spring Showers uses hanging branches, blossoms, lanterns and raindrops in the upper corners. Puddles and ground decorations are reserved for the lower corners.
CONFIGURATION
Generic Mod Config Menu is optional.
You can configure:
• Automatic seasonal switching
• A separate preset for every season
• One year-round preset
• Menu colours
• HUD colours
• Tooltip colours
• Seasonal farmer backgrounds
• An optional settings hotkey
The settings hotkey is unassigned by default.
The year-round preset is disabled while automatic seasonal switching is enabled.
REQUIREMENTS
• Stardew Valley 1.6
• SMAPI 4.0 or later
Generic Mod Config Menu is optional but recommended.
INSTALLATION
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Download and extract the mod.[/*]
[*]Place the SimpleUIThemes2 folder inside your Stardew Valley Mods folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]
[b]COMPATIBILITY[/b]
Simple UI Themes 2 supports standard Stardew Valley menus and many menus that use the game’s normal interface artwork.
It also includes layout support for:
• 48-slot and 60-slot backpacks
• Expanded chest interfaces
• Multi-panel storage menus
• Better Crafting buttons
• CJB Cheats Menu controls
• Simple Terminal Storage
NPC portraits, letters, maps, item sprites, clothing and world graphics are not recoloured.
Custom menus with completely separate artwork may need their own compatibility patch.
Do not enable Simple UI Themes and Simple UI Themes 2 together. Both mods recolour the same interface.

[b]PERFORMANCE[/b]
All decorations and glow effects are static.
The mod does not animate its artwork or track live texture animations from other UI mods. This avoids recurring texture rebuilding and periodic lag.

[b]LANGUAGES[/b]
• English
• French
• German
• Spanish
• Brazilian Portuguese
• Italian
• Russian
• Japanese
• Simplified Chinese
• Korean
• Turkish
• Hungarian
Preset names include the colour name in every supported language.

[b]UNINSTALLING[/b]
Simple UI Themes 2 is cosmetic and does not add save data.
Close the game and remove the SimpleUIThemes2 folder from Mods.
